name: Eselt
author: eselt

sections.description:
The Eselt WooCommerce Plugin seamlessly connects your WooCommerce store with the Eselt app, allowing you to easily manage and synchronize products across WooCommerce, eBay, and Amazon. The setup process is quick and guided directly through the Eselt app.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or newer
  • PHP 7.4 or newer
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or newer
  • Pretty permalinks enabled (the plugin can enable them automatically)
sections.installation:
1. Install the Eselt plugin either directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory or by uploading the plugin ZIP file through WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Open the Eselt page in the admin menu and click Connect to Eselt.
  4. Follow the steps in the Eselt app to finish connecting your store.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release with admin UI, requirement checks, permalink setup, API key generation, and Eselt app connection.

1.0.1

  • Improved usability when user is connected to the Eselt app.
